headline: Indo Tech Transformers bags order for steel plant in East India
summary: Indo Tech Transformers has announced the receipt of an order to supply power transformers for a steel plant located in the eastern region of India. The company informed the stock exchange about this development through a regulatory filing. Specific financial values and delivery timelines for the order were not disclosed in the initial announcement. For retail investors, major equipment orders provide visibility on future revenue execution for mid-cap electrical equipment manufacturers.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results reflecting order execution
why_it_matters: Order inflow boosts revenue visibility for Indo Tech

headline: Antique Stock Broking issues a buy rating on a T&D stock despite a 13% drop in 2026
hook: Brokerage backs power equipment amid price dip
summary: Antique Stock Broking has maintained a 'buy' rating on transmission and distribution (T&D) stock Indo Tech Gadgets despite a 13% price decline in 2026. The brokerage has outlined specific target prices, stop losses, and strategic rationales for the recommendation. Retail investors tracking the power sector can evaluate the brokerage's valuation thesis against current market corrections.
why_it_matters: Brokerage target offers perspective on T&D sector valuation drops
winners_losers: T&D stock investors gain clarity / cautious traders wait
